name: Grumman American AA-1 / AA-5
manufacturer: American Aviation / Grumman American / Gulfstream American
variants: AA-1 Yankee / AA-1A Trainer / AA-1B / AA-1C T-Cat & Lynx (two-seat)
summary: Light two- and four-seat low-wing singles with bonded aluminum construction and a sliding canopy, known for sporty handling.

wings: Short, constant-chord low wing with squared tips
fuselage: Sliding bubble canopy instead of doors
Fixed tricycle gear with skinny tubular main legs and a castering nose wheel
tail: Swept fin with conventional low horizontal tail

tellTales: Low-wing light single with a sliding canopy rather than doors
Fixed tricycle gear with skinny tubular main legs

confusedWith.howToTell: The PA-28 has a car-style door on the right and oleo-strut gear; the Grumman has a sliding canopy and slim tube main legs.
The Mooney has retractable gear and a forward-looking tail; the Grumman has fixed gear and a swept fin.
The Ercoupe has twin tail fins; the Grumman has a single fin.
The Cougar has an engine on each wing and a side door; the AA-1/AA-5 has one engine and a sliding canopy.
The AA-5 has a conventional tail and a sliding canopy; the Tomahawk has a T-tail and hinged doors.
The AA-5 has a sliding bubble canopy and a shorter, rounder fuselage; the Musketeer has a hinged-cabin four-seat layout and a taller swept fin.
